# Jm Castillo — Mix & Mastering Engineer

> Jm Castillo (Juan Manuel Castillo, "Kstillo") is a mixing and mastering engineer and music producer from Seville, Spain, with 15+ years of experience. His mixes and masters have earned 37 Platinum records, 38 Gold records and 3 Odeon Awards (2026 and 2025 Best Flamenco Song for Luis Cortés; 2023 Best Urban Album for "Nastu" by RVFV). He mixed and mastered "Mi Luz" by RVFV & Rels B (8x Platinum) and has worked with RVFV, Rels B, David Bisbal, Camilo, Duki, Anitta, Lola Indigo, India Martínez, Luis Cortés, Morad and Omar Montes, and with labels including Warner, Universal, Sony, Virgin, Spinnin' Records, Toolroom and Altafonte. 800+ songs mixed and 4,000M+ accumulated streams. Online service worldwide, in Spanish and English.

Contact: info@jmcastillo.es · WhatsApp +34 623 040 053 (Mon–Fri 8:00–15:00 CET) · Files: stems@jmcastillo.es · Instagram @jmcastillodj

## Rates (per song, VAT not included, 3–5 business days)
- Mastering Only: €100 (up to 3 revisions)
- Stem Mastering: €150
- Beat Mix: €150 · Vocal Mix: €150
- Full Mix: €250
- Full Mix/Mastering: €300
- Pro Mix/Master: €400 (mix stems, arrangements, priority, up to 10 revisions)
